a:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished high fidelity Chinese mobile puzzle game UI concept sheet, landscape 1536x1024. Input image is a STYLE AND LAYOUT REFERENCE ONLY, not an exact edit. Match the existing game: cream rounded panels, warm cocoa text and thin outlines, soft mint and honey yellow, tactile jelly blocks, friendly tiny yellow bean mascot with sprout, sunny cozy plant-filled room. Professional readable game UI, restrained soft highlights, no noisy ornament, no red annotation boxes or arrows, no watermark, no storefront. All UI text must be crisp simplified Chinese and precise percentages. Preserve an 8-column 10-row puzzle board and bottom next-row and two-tool dock from the reference. Remove the tutorial dialogue, NPC, hand and dark tutorial overlay so the board and UI are clear. Warm cozy background subordinate to HUD. Concept sheet composition: left 46% a full portrait gameplay view without a device frame, with correct redesigned HUD above the board, identical gameplay layout from reference; right 54% an enlarged closeup of the new HUD on clean cream background with generous breathing room, plus a small three-frame interaction storyboard below. Make the percentage the strongest reward information, cocoa large score separate from green collection percent. Use main preview score '2400', best '4800', progress '37.26%' shown with large integer and slightly smaller decimal but unmistakable percent. Overall collection progress must truly show 37% fill, NOT 100% fill. Main progress is collection toward ONE bean, NOT bean inventory; do not put bean inventory number beside it. Rule is each 100 face-bearing tiles cleared = 1%, so each tile is .01%; 10000 tiles = 100% = one bean. Exact small goal text '集满100%得1颗'. Do not invent '+1%' for each piece. No giant exposition on gameplay screen. Storyboard uses 3 small versions of the same widget, labeled '收集', '集满', '奖励': first has '37.32%' and 37% fill with two tiny face particles entering the mascot and subtle motion trails; second has '100%' and full meter with a gentle glow; third a tiny rising yellow bean and text '开心豆 +1', meter restarts subtly. Show visual motion cues tastefully; these are UI state thumbnails, not charts. Clean hierarchy and large legible typography.
VARIANT A, title text '方案 A · 得分下方居中', subtitle '分数与收集，共享中轴'. The redesigned top HUD is ONE wide cream rounded card, using the width of the existing board, with all principal content centered. Top center small '本局', below centered large '2400'. Best '最高 4800' in small cocoa text at top right of this unified card. Directly BELOW the current score, sharing EXACTLY the same horizontal center axis, a compact collection group: tiny yellow bean icon just to the left of a large green '37.26%' with the full icon-and-number group optically centered, then a slim horizontal rounded progress trough below filled 37% with mint-to-green jelly finish and a small pale glint on the leading edge. Goal label below in cocoa '集满100%得1颗'. Reduce useless padding; keep this HUD compact enough to avoid shrinking or covering the puzzle board. No right-side separate collection card in variant A. In the right enlarged closeup, center score and collection perfectly on one vertical line, with subtle design grid guide only OUTSIDE the gameplay mockup if needed; preferably no guides. Add tiny notes beneath the closeup '数字轻跳 · 进度缓动 · 满格奖励', not over gameplay. This variant should feel exceptionally simple, integrated and calm, with the horizontal bar providing immediate progress sense.
